name: vo.bing2.party.fixed-it.sauce.1
say: I did not cater this. I fixed it. There is a difference and the difference is eleven trays.

name: vo.bing2.party.fixed-it.gratin
say: Nobody asked you to fix it.

name: vo.bing2.party.fixed-it.sauce.2
say: Nobody asked the kitchen to serve that either. Here we are.

name: vo.bing2.party.the-corn.sauce.1
say: The corn came in the van. The corn is mine. Do not let Numbskull near the corn.

name: vo.bing2.party.the-corn.numbskull
say: I have not touched the corn.

name: vo.bing2.party.the-corn.sauce.2
say: You are standing in a corn posture.

name: vo.bing2.party.eleven-years.sauce.1
say: Eleven years I have eaten in this place. Tonight is the first night anybody let me cook in it. For HIM.

name: vo.bing2.party.eleven-years.irish
say: Would you rather nobody had asked?

name: vo.bing2.party.eleven-years.sauce.2
say: I would rather they asked eleven years ago.

name: vo.bing2.party.warm-not-hot.sauce
say: Second tray goes out warm at half eleven. Warm. Hot is for people who have earned hot.

name: vo.bing2.cleanup.the-van.sauce
say: The food goes back in the van. All of it. Nobody in this room is eating tonight and I am not binning good beef.

name: vo.bing2.attack.sauce
say: Not near the food. Whatever this is, not near the food.
direction: Not frightened and not shocked. A man moving a tray out of the way of weather.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.party.sauce.1
say: Plate. You are the only man in this room who has not eaten and it is starting to insult me.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.party.sauce.2
say: Billy asked me what was in the sauce. Eight years I have known him. He has never once asked what was in anything.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.party.bartender
say: Open bar, closed room. I have been told to keep pouring and to stop counting.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.party.dealer
say: The table is open. It is Mister Sputthole's table and it is Mister Sputthole's money. Play accordingly.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.party.security.1
say: Nobody comes through this door tonight. That includes people you know.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.party.security.2
say: I work for Mister Sputthole. I do not work the party. Enjoy yourself.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.cleanup.sauce
say: The food goes out covered, in my van, before anything else leaves this building. Nobody looks twice at a man carrying trays.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.cleanup.bartender
say: Every glass in the room, washed twice. Nobody asked me to. I would like that noticed.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.cleanup.dealer
say: Shoe is boxed, felt is brushed, chips are counted. I watched a comedian and I went home.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.cleanup.security
say: That door has not opened since eleven. It is what I will say, and it is also true.

name: vo.bing2.lou.sweep_order
say: He is gone. Now the room. Every surface, every corner, the whole of it, once, properly. Then you have never been here.
direction: Quiet and completely level. He is not angry, he is closing a shift.

name: vo.bing2.lou.leave_now
say: Out the back with Snow. Do not stop in the lot and do not use the front.

name: vo.bing2.snow.carry
say: Take him. Through the store room, out the back, straight into the trunk. Do not put him down.
direction: Instructions, not encouragement. He has said this to somebody before.

name: vo.bing2.booski.shot_offer
say: Prospect, how about a shot?
direction: Not a question. Warm, flat, and already looking at the bartender.

name: vo.bing2.sauce.plate
say: Eat something. Now, while it is still a party.
direction: Handing over a plate the man did not ask for and will not be allowed to refuse.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.party.aubbie
say: I have been awake since Tuesday and now I am at a party. Do not ask me what I have been working on.
retiredText: Microphone cable is fixed. Do not step on the new splice.

name: vo.bing2.walkup.cleanup.aubbie
say: Correct plastic is in storage. The shower curtain was Snow.
retiredText: Correct plastic is in storage. The shower curtain was Lawnmower.

name: vo.bing2.lou.briefing
say: Prospect. The men's room, Aubbie's kit, and every piece of him that came off this floor. Then Billy travels.
direction: Turning panic into departments. Flat, fast, and completely unbothered.
retiredText: Prospect. Both bathrooms, Aubbie's kit, and every piece of him that came off. Then me.
